stem.text: Plant cells with the same water potential in their cytoplasm were each put into one of three different concentrations of sugar solution, 10%, 5% and 2.5%.
The cells were left for 50 minutes and then observed using a light microscope.

stem.alt: Light microscope drawing of a plant cell labelled cell X, with a vacuole labelled by a leader line.
Light microscope drawing of a plant cell labelled cell Y.
Light microscope drawing of a plant cell labelled cell Z.

items: Cell Y had a lower water potential than the sugar solution it was put into.
Cell Z was put into the 10% sugar solution.
Cell Z had a less negative water potential than the sugar solution it was put into.
